and improvements on Transferee's Land (said new building and/or improvements being herein collectively called “Transferee's New Building"); and WHEREAS, Transferee's New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the “Zoning Resolution")of the City of New York, as amended from time to time, than is now available for use in respect of Transferee's Land under the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Land, and Transferor's Land, into a single “zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by Transferee's New Building with such limitation, which procedure willmake available toTransfereefor such purpose theTransferredDevelopmentRights(assuch term is hereinafter defined) attributable to the Transferor's Land and the Bonus Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) associated therewith, if any, (subject to the restrictions and limitations setforth in thePurchaseAgreement); and WHEREAS, Transferee and Transferor are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in

the form annexed hereto as Exhibit I (the “Declaration"), which makes such procedure available to Transferee for such purpose by creating a single:zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") out of Transferee's Land and Transferor's Land; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing.and the sum of ten ($10.00) dollars each to the other in hand paid, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, Transferee and Transferor hereby agree as follows: (1) Certain Definitions.
